rows.note: Use 壞咗 as the all-purpose casual choice when a device is not working or has broken down.

example.english: The air conditioner has a malfunction, so the whole room is hot.
example.traditional: 部冷氣壞咗，搞到成間房都好熱。
example.jyutping: bou6 laang5 hei3 waai6 zo2 gaau2 dou3 sing4 gaan1 fong4 dou1 hou2 jit6

rows.note: Use 運作唔正常 when the device still works but is behaving irregularly or improperly.

example.english: The printer has a malfunction: it still prints, but the words often come out crooked.
example.traditional: 部打印機仲印到嘢，但係運作唔正常，啲字成日印歪。
example.jyutping: bou6 daa2 jan3 gei1 zung6 jan3 dou3 je5 daan6 hai6 wan6 zok3 m4 zing3 soeng4 di1 zi6 seng4 jat6 jan3 waai1

rows.note: Use 出故障 when specifically describing a machine or system developing a fault.

example.english: The subway signalling system has a malfunction, so the trains have to run slowly.
example.traditional: 地鐵訊號系統出故障，班車要慢駛。
example.jyutping: dei6 tit3 seon3 hou6 hai6 tung2 ceot1 gu3 zoeng3 baan1 ce1 jiu3 maan6 sai2
